Jwt._comment: Dev-only signing key, safe to commit (same convention as the ConnectionStrings default above). Real deployments MUST override this via Jwt__SigningKey.

Mfa._comment: M6: TOTP now exists, so enforcement is on by default. MfaAuthorizationHandler still only requires it from accounts that have actually enrolled (mfa_enabled claim) — see docs/architecture/IMPLEMENTATION_READINESS.md §4.

Recaptcha._comment: Empty = feature off (fail-open), same convention as ForgeHub/Darckware. Set Recaptcha__SecretKey once a key pair is provisioned in the Google reCAPTCHA admin console for this domain.
